## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant Chromium/WebKit Playwright tests

## Detector/privacy checklist

- [ ] Detector changes include regression scenarios and tradeoffs, or no detector behavior changed.
- [ ] No credentials, private exports, location history, or sensor recordings are included.
- [ ] Production UI exposes no diagnostics, mocks, replay controls, or raw sensor data.
- [ ] Documentation reflects permission, offline, privacy, or browser-limitation changes.
